WITH pill_device AS (
  SELECT device_id, (raw_data->>'pairedDeviceId')::uuid AS controller_id
  FROM devices WHERE trim(device_name) = trim($1) AND device_type = 'pill' LIMIT 1
),
matched_recipe AS (
  SELECT recipe_id, name AS recipe_name, style_name, og, fg, yeast_name
  FROM recipes WHERE $4 IS NOT NULL AND trim(lower(name)) = trim(lower($4)) LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO batches (pill_device_id, temp_controller_device_id, start_date, beer_name, status, recipe_id)
  SELECT pd.device_id, pd.controller_id, $3, $2, 'active', mr.recipe_id
  FROM pill_device pd
  LEFT JOIN matched_recipe mr ON true
  RETURNING batch_id, pill_device_id, temp_controller_device_id, recipe_id
)
SELECT
  i.batch_id,
  i.pill_device_id,
  i.temp_controller_device_id,
  i.recipe_id,
  (SELECT device_name FROM devices WHERE device_id = i.temp_controller_device_id) AS controller_name,
  mr.recipe_name, mr.style_name, mr.og, mr.fg, mr.yeast_name
FROM inserted i
LEFT JOIN matched_recipe mr ON mr.recipe_id = i.recipe_id;

WITH pill_device AS (
  SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE trim(device_name) = trim($1) AND device_type = 'pill' LIMIT 1
),
batch_info AS (
  SELECT b.batch_id, b.beer_name, b.current_phase, b.prep_alerted_for_phase, b.start_date,
         b.temp_controller_device_id, pd.device_id AS pill_id
  FROM batches b
  JOIN pill_device pd ON pd.device_id = b.pill_device_id
  WHERE b.status = 'active'
  LIMIT 1
),
controller_info AS (
  SELECT device_name AS controller_name FROM devices WHERE device_id = (SELECT temp_controller_device_id FROM batch_info)
),
pill_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', time_utc, 'sg', gravity_sg, 'temp', temperature_c) ORDER BY time_utc ASC) AS series
  FROM pill_readings WHERE device_id = (SELECT pill_id FROM batch_info)
),
controller_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', time_utc, 'temp', temperature_c, 'target', target_temperature_c) ORDER BY time_utc ASC) AS series
  FROM temp_controller_readings WHERE device_id = (SELECT temp_controller_device_id FROM batch_info)
),
control_series AS (
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('t', changed_at, 'old', old_value, 'new', new_value, 'by', changed_by, 'remark', remark) ORDER BY changed_at ASC) AS series
  FROM control_log
  WHERE device_id = (SELECT temp_controller_device_id FROM batch_info)
    AND action = 'set_target_temperature'
    AND changed_at >= (SELECT start_date FROM batch_info)
)
SELECT
  bi.batch_id::text AS batch_id, bi.beer_name, bi.current_phase, bi.prep_alerted_for_phase, bi.start_date,
  ci.controller_name,
  COALESCE(ps.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS pill_series,
  COALESCE(cs.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS controller_series,
  COALESCE(ctl.series, '[]'::jsonb) AS control_series
FROM (SELECT 1) AS anchor
LEFT JOIN batch_info bi ON true
LEFT JOIN controller_info ci ON true
LEFT JOIN pill_series ps ON true
LEFT JOIN controller_series cs ON true
LEFT JOIN control_series ctl ON true;

INSERT INTO phase_log (batch_id, gravity_sg, temperature_c, gravity_velocity, detected_phase, ai_reasoning, controller_temp_c, target_temperature_c, abv_percent)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($3, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($4, 'null')::numeric, $5, $6, NULLIF($7, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($8, 'null')::numeric, NULLIF($9, 'null')::numeric);
UPDATE batches SET current_phase = $1, prep_alerted_for_phase = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN NULL ELSE prep_alerted_for_phase END WHERE batch_id = $2;

WITH pill_device AS (
  SELECT device_id FROM devices WHERE trim(device_name) = trim($1) AND device_type = 'pill' LIMIT 1
),
batch_info AS (
  SELECT b.batch_id, b.beer_name, b.temp_controller_device_id
  FROM batches b
  JOIN pill_device pd ON pd.device_id = b.pill_device_id
  WHERE b.status = 'active'
  LIMIT 1
),
controller_info AS (
  SELECT device_name AS controller_name FROM devices WHERE device_id = (SELECT temp_controller_device_id FROM batch_info)
),
last_target AS (
  SELECT target_temperature_c FROM temp_controller_readings
  WHERE device_id = (SELECT temp_controller_device_id FROM batch_info)
  ORDER BY time_utc DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  bi.batch_id::text AS batch_id,
  bi.beer_name,
  bi.temp_controller_device_id::text AS temp_controller_device_id,
  ci.controller_name,
  lt.target_temperature_c AS current_target
FROM (SELECT 1) AS anchor
LEFT JOIN batch_info bi ON true
LEFT JOIN controller_info ci ON true
LEFT JOIN last_target lt ON true;

INSERT INTO control_log (device_id, action, old_value, new_value, changed_by, remark)
VALUES ($1, 'set_target_temperature', NULLIF($2,'null'), $3, $4, NULLIF($5,'null'));

  jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', name, 'style_name', style_name) ORDER BY name) AS recipes,
  COUNT(*) AS recipe_count,
  MAX(last_synced_at) AS last_synced_at
FROM recipes
WHERE (NULLIF($1, 'null')::text IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || NULLIF($1, 'null')::text || '%');
